newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 19.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Tuesday.
* Teamsters union officials said they and the United Parcel Service reached a tentative agreement to end the Teamsters' 15-day strike.
* Space station Mir's main computer failed and sent the craft spinning out of control as it was docking with a cargo ship.
* Leaders of the U.S.'s largest Lutheran denomination agreed to close cooperation with three other denominations, but rejected establishing similar ties with the Episcopal Church.
* A state jury in Louisiana ruled that Dow Chemical knowingly deceived women about the health risks of silicone used in breasts implants.
